أنتقل (form VIII)
# أَنْتَقِلُ (ʔantaqilu) /ʔan.ta.qi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# أُنْتَقَلُ (ʔuntaqalu) /ʔun.ta.qa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# أَنْتَقِلَ (ʔantaqila) /ʔan.ta.qi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# أُنْتَقَلَ (ʔuntaqala) /ʔun.ta.qa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
